name: Priyank Pathak Scholarship for B.Sc. Agriculture (4th Year) Students
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in the 4th year of the B.Sc. Agriculture program at Govind Ballabh Pant University of Agriculture and Technology, Pantnagar. 1. The scholarship is awarded for a duration of one year only.
